summary: Migrated legacy-netapp to node2 at 10.100.130.11:4180. Health, identity, worker distribution, firewall behavior, persistence configuration, and required hostname mapping were verified. Node1’s listener and active policy were retired while files remained intact.
actions_performed: Configured two enabled unprivileged SO_REUSEPORT workers on node2
Installed preserved application and identity data
Configured nftables-backed iptables policy with stateful handling, rate-limited logging, app-LAN allow, and client-LAN rejection
Mapped legacy-netapp.service.lan to node2 on both nodes
Disabled node1 workers and removed its application firewall chain
Added boot-safe network waits and verified service enablement
